import sys

def main():
    dna = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    total = 0
    
    if not dna:
        print(0)
        return
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(dna):
        base = dna[i]
        start = i
        while i < len(dna) and dna[i] == base:
            i += 1
        if (i - start) % 2 == 0:
            total += 1
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
